evidence: Live 12:10Z /pokemon-30th-anniversary-2026: 'Mew #G/RGB $3,675 sold · Sep 25'. indices.json TH26 G/RGB price 3674.5, n30 28, basis 'sold (PriceCharting ungraded, 30d median)', asOf 2026-09-25.
Live /bowman-2026-index: 'Andrew Fischer #CPA-AF $145 sold · Sep 25'; column 'Last sold' $144.63 (30d median of 30). /bowman-bangers the same minute: last printed sale $144.26 on Sep 23.

Generator tools/build-chase-strip.mjs:89. Strip on 9 pages (ascended-heroes-index, bowman-1st-chrome-index, bowman-2026-index, chaos-rising-index, destined-rivals-index, pitch-black-index, pokemon-30th-anniversary-2026, prismatic-evolutions-index, scarlet-violet-151-index).
